༄༅/ /mo khrid mkha' 'gro'i myur lam bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mo khrid mkha' 'gro'i myur lam bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rje btsun a ba dhū tī pa btsun mo can la phyag 'tshal lo// bde ba'i gar mkhan gyis sbyar yid kyi dpyid// bde rgyas kun tu gzugs kyi bcom ldan ma// bde chen 'dod pa'i snying la dga' char bzhin// bde legs rtag tu mdzad der phyag 'tshal lo// 'dod rgyas bslab pas gdams pa'i ri dwags mig /'dod rgyu gnas skabs bzhi yi sgrib bcom nas// 'dod dgongs snying po'i bsam gtan la gzhol bas// 'dod don bla ma grub pa 'di na ko /gnyis pa phag mo byin rlabs kyi dkor mdzod kha phye nas mtshan ldan gyi bud med ye shes kyi sa la skyel ba la/ lam gyi chings dang*/ lam dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ cig car thod brgal rim gyis bkri ba'i lam gsum gyi/ cig car ba ni bla ma rtogs pa dang ldan pa dang slob ma mos gus can phrad pa'i mod la tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas 'grub pa dpal sha ba ra dang*/ rgyal po sa kar siddhi lta bu'o// 'bring byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang gis rgyud grol te bskyed rdzogs la bslab par bya bas srid pa bar ma dor mchog grub pa rje btsun mai tri pa lta bu/ 'di'i dbang du mdzad nas sindhu ra'i byin brlabs sngar bstan nas phyis lam gyi rim pa bstan la/ gsum pa dbang po tha ma dbang rim gyis bskur te so so'i lam la bslab pa bdag cag lta bu/ 'dir phyi ma'o// gnyis pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba thun mong gis rgyud sbyang ba/ dngos gzhi gsang ba'i nye lam la brten nas tshe gcig lus gcig gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa gnyis/ dang po/ snying gi nor bu bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor bsgyur nas sprul pa'i skur 'tshang rgya bar byed pa rin po che lta bu'i gdams ngag bum dbang gi lam/ mtshan ma'i snang ba ye shes su khyer nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'tshang rgya bar byed pa rin po che lta bu'i gdams ngag gsang dbang gi lam/

zhu ba'i bde ba rnam bcas su bslang nas chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya bar byed pa rin po che lta bu'i gdam ngag dbang gsum pa'i lam/ dmigs bcas thams cad dmigs med du ro mnyam ste lhan cig skyes pa'i skur 'tshang rgya bar byed pa rin po che lta bu'i gdams ngag dbang bzhi pa'i lam/ bya spyod thams cad he ru ka'i rol mor btang nas btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya bar byed pa rin po che lta bu'i gdams ngag spyod pa 'jigs bral rdo rje'i mtshon cha lnga las/ dang po la lus sku rdo rjer ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang*/ smin nas grol bar byed pa bskyed rim gnyis/ phyi ma la/ rtsa rgyud las/ he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor mchog /slob dpon rnal 'byor ma nyid yin// rgyud 'di ru ni rnal 'byor pa// legs par 'gyur ba nyid yin te// zhes he ru ka'i gtso bo 'phos pas yum bka'i mai tri zhabs bzhed pa ltar/ spros pa can bcu gsum gyi 'khor lo dang*/ ku sā li ma bden gnyis zhal gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa gnyis/ gnyis pa mtshan ma'i snang ba ye shes su khyer nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'tshang rgya bar byed pa rin po che lta bu'i gdams ngag gsang dbang gi lam la/ ngag gsung rdo rje ma smin par byed pa gsang dbang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa chos drug gnyis las/ phyi ma la mtshan 'dzin ye shes kyi mer spar ba gtum mo// mtshan 'dzin sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor du ngo sprod pa sgyu lus/ mtshan 'dzin dag snang rab 'byams su khyer ba 'od gsal/ mtshan 'dzin ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong du byed pa rmi lam/ mtshan 'dzin zung 'jug gi bcud du len pa bar do// mtshan 'dzin ye shes kyi dbyings su btang ba 'pho ba dang drug gzhan snying gi nor bu bzhin la/ bsnyen sgrub yi dam gyi gtum mo'i lha phag mo gtso bo dang*/ bcom ldan 'das de la 'khyud bya de bzhin sngags bzla ba la thog mar yum dang*/ de nas yab go brje ba 'dren 'grems kyi 'khrul 'khor med pa tsam mo// gsum pa zhu ba'i bde ba rnam bcas su bslang nas chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i dbang gsum pa'i lam la/

yid thugs rdo rjer ma smin pa smin par byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa btsan thabs pho nya'i lam gnyis las/ phyi ma la/ rlung sbyang ba bsnyen pa/ rang lus sgrub pa/ gzhan lus sgrub chen bshad pa gsum las/ dang po la/ nus pa dang ldan pas pho lus su bsgyur ba/ mi ldan pas padma chu 'thung la bslab pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum sngon 'gro ni/ phongs sar bzhag rkang mthil sprad pa pad skyil te gdan la bcar phab/ lag pa gnyis kyi khu tshur nu ma g.yas pa'i zur nas bzhar te steng gi nam mkhar brgyangs kyis 'then pa dang rlung phyir 'bud bstun pa gsum byed/ de bzhin g.yon/ cha mnyam du/ de nas rlung smad du sdig pa dang lhan du khu tshur nu ma g.yas pa'i zur gnyis nas mar bzhar te gsang gnas su 'ded/ dmigs pa nu ma'i tog nang du log nas gsang gnas su rdo rjer song bar bsam pa gsum/ de bzhin g.yon dang dbus su'ang bya/ mthar rlung kha sbyar rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas nu ma'i mtha' bskor zhing brdung*/ g.yas nas gsang gnas su 'ded/ de bzhin g.yon dang dbus su/ dngos gzhi ni/ 'bebs gdan khru gang gi stegs bur/ rlung ro bsal/ rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas nu ma g.yas pa bzhar te spyi bor 'then dus langs nam mkhar bsgrengs/ nu ma de spyi bor brgyangs kyis 'thon par bsam/ phyir tsam thub 'dzin/ 'bebs dus phyag rgya des nu ma g.yas zur du shed dang ldan pas drag por 'ded/ nu ma'i tog nang du log nas gsang bar rdo rjer song bar bsam la phongs rdeb/ de bzhin g.yon dang dbus su de yang yang sbyong*/ rjes ni pad skyil gyi steng nas rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas nu ma stod nas rim gyis thur du 'ded do// des nu ma rang dag tu song bas padma'i ze'u 'bru je cher song ste rdo rjer 'gyur/ 'gram gnyis je hril la song ste 'bras bur 'gyur ro// brtag gnyis las/

nu ma spangs pa bo lar 'gyur// kakko la dbus yang dag ldan// 'gram gnyis dril bu nyid du 'gyur// ze'u 'bru bo la can du 'gyur// lhag ma bdag nyid chen po nyid// ces so// gnyis pa la/ rlung sbyang ba/ 'byongs nas chu 'thung la bslab pa/ cha lag bstan pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ padma skad 'don gyi 'khrul 'khor te/ gyad kyi bgrad/ seng ge'i rdeb/ stag mo'i 'dzum 'don no// dang po pad skyil la rkang mgo padma nas mtho gang tsam par bzhag de lag pa gnyis kyis bzung rlung rang 'gag byas te rgya mtsho g.yas nas g.yon du bdun bskor/ rlung zhabs ma lus par phyir shed bskyed la 'bud/ de dus mkhal ma gnyis kyi rlung stod du 'then pas ka ba btsugs/ mi thub pa dang ka ba mi 'gyur bar byas brngubs nas mdun rlung drag tu 'phul/ yang stod la mkhal 'then gyis 'phul/ yang mdun du brdab pa lan gsum rjes su rkang mgo bzung ba bgrad la bteg pa dang*/ phongs sa nas 'phag mnyam du shed bskyed la brdab bo// de bzhin g.yas/ cha mnyam du gnyis pa phongs sar bzhag rkang pa gnyis kyi bar la mtho gang tsam la pus mo tsog pur byas la pus steng du khu tshur bzhag rang 'gag gi ngang nas gsus pa g.yas nas g.yon du lan bdun bskor/ kha nas he zhes phyir tsam thub tsam cig bzung*/ mi thub pa dang brngubs la gzhan 'dra/ pus mo dang khu tshur ma bral bar har langs pus mo ma gug par thang gis brgyangs pa'i ngang nas rkang pa mdun du shad brkyang ba dang phongs bstan la shed bskyed la 'bebs so// gsum pa phongs sa la bzhag rkang pa mdun du gshibs/ pus mo tsog byas/ phyi nas sor mo bsnol bas 'khyud/ rlung rang 'gag gis g.yas g.yon du bskor ba sogs dang po 'dra/ phongs bteg sa la rdeb pa dang mnyam du pus mo gnyis kyang phrad byas rlung mdun du shed bskyed la 'phul lo// des zla phyed sbyangs pas phyi'i rtags padma'i steng gi gsus chung la rtsa sngon po smyug ma tsam gcig gam gnyis gsum gang rigs 'byung*/

de nas gang gi 'khrul 'khor la bskor rdeb bzhag nas lus gnad gang gi steng nas yin kyang phyir 'bud drag po de dus mdun 'then/ mi thub pa dang nang du brngubs la mdun rlung shed bskyed la thur du 'phul ba zhag bdun sbyang*/ nang rtags su rlung sna nas brngubs pa padmar skad dang bcas 'thon pa'o// gsang rtags srog thur 'dres pas nad kun las thar ro// gal te 'byongs dka' na lus skyil krung lhod de ba/ rlung bzung lto ba g.yas g.yon du lan bdun brdabs/ rlung phyir 'bud kyis kha nas sgregs pas 'don no// de bzhin g.yon g.yas/ dbus la'ang byas pa/ rlung yar sang mar sang du 'gro'o// 'byongs nas chu 'thung la bslab pa ni/ chu bzang bre gang tsam gdul nas phul gang du song ba de rdza'i snod gtsang mar blug la drod yod tsam gyis bha ga'i 'og tu bzhag lus gnad sems skyil lag pa pus mor bkab nas 'dren pa/ ru sbal bskum pa'i pus mo bgrad pas/ pad skyil gyi rgyu ma khugs nas lag pas 'dzin pas/ rkang brkyang gi rgyu ma khugs nas lag pas 'dzin pa/ pus btsugs lag pa brla steng du bzhag pas 'dren pa lnga gang bde/ rlung gnad phyir 'bud kyis 'dren pa la/ snga sor steng rlung 'og tu mnan/ de nas rlung phyir 'bud drag po dang bstun lto ba yar 'then pas so// rigs gcig la kha nas phyir 'bud dang bstun pas 'drongs/ rlung byang ba mdun rlung 'then rgyab rlung mnan pas so// 'drongs nas lto ba bskor zhing brdabs la/ steng rlung thur du bsdigs pas 'bod/ de nas 'o ma la bslab/ de kha sna gnyis nas 'ong bar bya ba/ padma'i thad du lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gyi rgyab sprad de btsugs/ dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i pho bskor pho rdeb byas/ rlung rang bkag ste smad du brgyangs de nas pho khar brgyangs/ yang smad du/ yang pho kha/ de ltar lan gsum byas pa'i rjes la phyir 'bud drag po dang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis 'chun bskyed la spyi bor brkyang*/

mar log sna'i thad tsam du sleb pa dang rlung brngubs mdun nas mar sngar bzhin btsugs/ de'i ngang nas rlung de stod la shed bskyed la phul bas kha sna gnyis kar 'ong*/ sna bug so sor 'thon par byed na/ rlung g.yas rgyu dang bstun pus mo lag ngar sa la btsugs nas/ pus mo gnyis kyi bar la bskum khru gang bzhag pa'i pus mo g.yas cung zad mdun du ring bar byas/ de'i 'og nas lag sor bsnol bas 'khyud/ dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i dus su rlung rang 'gag de steng du thang gis 'then/ bar du brgyangs/ g.yas nas g.yon du lan gsum bskor/ g.yon du lan gcig bskor ba rlung sna nas shed bskyed la g.yas phyogs su 'bud do// de sna g.yas nas 'thon 'ong*/ de bzhin bzlog pas g.yon du'ang*/ dbus nas gnyis kar yang bya'o// 'di dag gi 'then dus rlung gnad 'ba' zhig gis 'then ma thub na thur ma btsugs rgyab thur kyang rlung gnad 'di rnams kyis the mi tshom// gsum pa cha lag bstan pa ni/ skyes pa'i gnod pa bsrung ba'i padma kha sdom la rgyun du gsang ba'i skyil krung byas/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur brtsegs pa pus mor/ rlung lte bar mnan/ padma'i rlung yar 'then pa'o// rtsa rigs nges na so sor rgyas pa bzhin no// khug chos kha ma bye ba/ spang rgyan kha ma bye ba/ dril shang dkar po kha ma bye ba me tog 'bus tsam/ bya pho'i og zhol/ rma bya'i mdongs rnams zhib par btags/ phyed mar dang sbyar te thun gsum du padma la byug phyed rtsa stong la chang dang sbyar te ltor btang ngo*// padma ther 'bud ni/ 'og sgo glod/ mdun rlung mdun rang la brgyangs nas 'phul/ yang rlung bzung la mdun du shed bskyed la 'phul/ skyes pa'i gnod pa byung dus rdo rjes glags mi rnyed pa'am/ chud kyang nang du mi 'chags so// gnyis pa rang lus bsgrub pa la/ sngon 'gro lag pa'i sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi bo la'i sbyor ba/ rjes 'dren 'grems 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad gsum las/

dang po ni/ rkang pa sems skyil lhod byas/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum byin brlab go bgo a las padma ze'u 'bru hrīḥmatshan pa phaṭ kyis bu ga bkag pa/ mtheb srin 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ stag sham gyi mdun nas cung zad grol bas 'khyud pa de'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ gyis nor bu mtshan pa phaṭ kyis bu ga bkag pa snyoms par zhugs par bsgoms te/ des padma mnyes/ khams g.yos/ bde ba'i steng du dran shes ma yengs par byas pas lam du btang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ shing pho shing rang gi bha ga la ran pa sbom phra mdzub mo tsam pa phyi thums phying pa rdo rje'i dbyibs byas/ der tshil bzhus pa'i steng du/ snying zho sha spa ma'i khanda/ gla rtsi/ rusta/ kha che/ me tog glang sna dmar po/ ri sgog rtsa dkar gyi rtsa ba yod tsam/ sgog gcig phyed/ rusta/ rgya tshwa/ go bo'i brun/ dung srin med/ g.yer ma mtshon cig btab pa btags/ phying pa de gtso/ zhal ba lta bur byas pa/ dbyar yin na ldum ra'i rgya sho rlon pa char gyis tshim pa'i rtsa ba dang rkang gi bar na dkar dmar 'dres pa'i 'jag 'jog yod pa de'i nang la mkhrang byed du smyug ma brdzangs pa bha ga la ran pas yab dang yum sngar bzhin rang ngam grogs rigs mthun gyis skyes pa bzhin du bskyod/ bde ba cher skyes pa dran shes kyis ma yengs par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ 'dzin lnga sbyor ba'i 'dug stangs gang yin gyi steng nas rlung spyi bo'i bar gang bas 'dzin/ yang stod du brgyangs la btsan thabs brgyab la 'dzin/ yang rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol la der kha sbyar gyis 'dzin/ yang lag pa gang bde/ rlung steng 'og bar gsum kha sbyar pho bar bzung lto ba mdun du phul bas 'dzin/ yang mdun rlung 'then steng rlung brngub pa rgyab tu 'phul bas 'dzin/ 'di dag 'khor lo so sor phab pa rang sa nas bzlog pa la bya/

gzhan du phyi ma nyid do// de nas 'byed pa ni/ rlung pho bar bzung ste lus g.yas g.yon du bcag pho ba btsubs nas rlung 'jam po sum bstud du 'bud/ mthar rlung brngubs la lto ba bskor zhing rdeb gtsub gang thub kyis gtsub pa/ de nas 'dren bya ba la rlung kha sbyar stod la 'then pa dang*/ phyir 'bud 'jam pos 'dren pa dang*/ yang phyir 'bud drag pos 'dren pa'o// de nas padma skad 'don gyi 'khrul 'khor rnams bya'o// de nas snyigs ma 'bod par byed pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi ste/ 'bod chung*/ ru sbal gan rkyal/ ru sbal kha sbub/ 'bod chen po/ dang po/ tsog pu pus mo phyir bskyed pa'i khar khu tshur bzhag 'og glod/ steng rlung thur la sdig phongs rting pa la 'chun che bar rdeb pa'o// gnyis pa gan rkyal du yan lag bskum byas ste rlung mnan te thur sdig gsum pa pus btsugs kyi steng du khu tshur bzhag la steng rlung thur du sdig de dus pus mo phrad byed pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ 'bebs stan gyi steng du phongs bzhag la langs dus lag pa mthe bong sprel ba spyi bor 'then pa dang rlung kha sbyar 'then pa mnyam du byas/ lag pa rgyu zhabs g.yas su bsnun pa/ rlung sdig pa/ phongs rdeb pa/ rkang pa bgrad pa bzhi mnyam du bya'o// de bzhin g.yon dbus su/ de nas 'grems pa la dwangs 'grems snyigs 'grems/ dwangs 'grems la stong par gnyis/ dang po/ lus skyil krung rlung rang sor bzhag pa phyir 'gro ba'i tshe pad kyis bcad la gang thub kyi ring bzhag pa smad rang 'dar sil gyis 'ong*/ de dus lus sil li li sprug bar 'grems/ rlung nang du gnas pa'i mtshams bcad la bzhag pas lus 'dar sil li li 'ong*/ de dus lus byin sprug pa'o// snyigs ma 'grems pa la stod smad bar gyi rnam rol gsum rkang pa skyil krung lag pa'i sor mos sna/ mig rna ba kha mthe bong gis mgrin pa'i rba rlabs ltem/ rlung kha sbyar mgo la 'then zhing bzung nas mdun du khugs tshad bkug

yang rgyab tu dgyed/ rlung mi thub pa'i dus mgo dang lag pa mdun du sprug rjes su rlung gang 'bud thub pa gsum stod kyi rnam rol/ skyil krung lag gnyis bsnol bas mchan rtsa bsdam/ sked pa g.yas g.yon du bskor/ mthar lus si li sprug pa bar gyi rnam rol/ skyil krung lag gnyis mkhal rtsa mnan nas skyil krung dang phongs re mos rdeb/ mthar rdeb pa smad kyi rnam rol/ de'i mthar rlung bum pa can kha re sgom shes pa phyag chen gyi rtsis gzung ste mnyam gzhag rgyun ci ring bskyang ngo*// gsum pa gzhan lus bsgrub chen bshad pa la/ sngon 'gro dpa' bo brtag dgug dngos gzhi mnyam par sbyor ba/ rjes lam du 'khyer ba'i gnad bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ rang nyid kyi rigs nges pas rigs kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i dpa' bo ma rnyed na lang tsho la gnas pa su yang rung ngo*// dgug pa ni/ rdzas sngags ting 'dzin bsnyen bkur sogs kyis so// gnyis pa ni/ de dang chags pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs kyis bde ba bskul/ 'khor lo sdom pa dang rang rnal 'byor mar bskyed mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab par bya/ rang rtsa bzang na de'i rdo rje'i bu gar bcug dal bur bsnun pas bde ba mi bzod pa skye/ gal te rtsa ngan na de'i nor bus 'gram yun ring du mnyes te nang du gzhug de nas dal bur bskyod du bcug pa rlung nus zhan na bde ba spyi bor sogs nas bzlog ste rim pas je mar phab/ mgrin 'khor du dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga' lte bar khyad dga'/ gsang bar lhan skyes/ dus kyi skad cig ma bzhi/ yul gyi stong bzhi rtogs par bya'o// nus pa dang rtsa rigs bzang na gsang rtse phrad sar phab/ de dus stong pa nyid la gzhag pas bde ba de rnam bcas su ldang*/ de dpe'i ye shes/ de kas rang 'ching*/ med na rtsol ba'i 'dzin sogs bya/ de nas de dus kyi bde ba mtshon byed du byas na phyag rgya dang bral ba'i skabs thams cad du de bsgom zhing des snang ba gang shar de'i rol par khyer ro// de yang yang sbyangs pa ji zhig na rnam med kyi bde ba chen po rtogs te rlung sems dbu mar thim mo// dbang po rno na skad cig ma der 'tshang rgya la 'bring na stan thog gcig tu sa lam rdzogs shing*/

rtul nas dang po nas rim gyis so// gsum pa la/ 'dug stangs dang*/ rjes shes lam du khyer ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor dus kyi 'dug stangs drug ste/ nyi ma dag byed ni/ rang gan rkyal lag pa brla'i nang nas mar btang phyir 'khyud la rkang pa'i mtheb chen 'dzin pa'i steng du yab bzhag pas so// rakta gyen 'dren ni/ rang gan rkyal gyi steng du yab/ rang gi rkang pa de'i rgyab tu bsnol ba'i mthe bong nas lag pas bzung*/ ru sbal kha sbub ni/ rang steng du gnas pa'i pus mo btsugs/ lag pa'i gru mo gnyis yab kyi brang khar bcar gyis phab pa'o// ru sbal gan rkyal ni/ de bzlog pa'o// bgrad pa'i sbyor ba ni/ rang dang de'i gsang gnas sprad pa'i rkang pa brkyang pas so sor dgyed pas lus ku ru khar song ba/ brkyang ba'i sbyor ba ni/ rang gi rkang pa brkyang ba'i khar yab kyi phongs bzhag la rkang pa brkyang ste bskyod pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'dzin dang po nyi ma dag byed bzhin la/ 'jam rlung phyir tsam thub 'dzin/ dbang sogs gyen du bzlog go /mi thub pa dang nang du brngubs la bsdigs bskyur byas/ mdun du phul tsam byas pa'i ngang nas 'jam rlung phyir tsam thub 'dzin pa/ yang na phra mtshams nas pus mo'i phyi zur gnyis nas btang bas bzung*/ kha nas ha zhes/ gzhan snga ma bzhin/ yang yab kyi dpyi mgo'i steng du rang gi lag pa bsnol/ rkang mgo gnyis bzung*/ rlung phyir shed bskyed la phul/ mi thub pa dang hab kyis kha nas brngub snying ga yan du gzung*/ smad kyi rlung zhabs de stod du thang gis 'then/ stod kyi rlung sna gnyis nas phyir shed bskyed la 'phul phyir tsam thub 'dzin/ dbang sogs gyen du bzlog 'byed 'dren 'bod pa rang lus las byung ba bzhin byas pa'i mthar/ srid srung la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/ dang po 'bebs stan kun rdzogs bzhin la rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du khru gang yod pa byas/ rlung bzung yar har gyis langs rlung shed bskyed la 'bud/

lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gan rkyal gyis ro brkyang bshud de spyi bor brkyang g.yas g.yon du gcus te rlung sems bsres/ mi thub pa dang brngubs/ 'og sgo gnyis su shed bskyed la 'phul/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur kha sbub pas ro brkyang mar bshud/ mdun du 'bebs pa dang phongs rdeb pa bstun/ 'di phyi dro nas bstan/ de'i dgong brgya/ sang zhogs nyis brgya/ de dgong bzhi brgya/ de'i sang brgyad brgya/ de'i dgong stong ra can no// 'bebs pa de'i sang zhogs rtseg dus bzhin tshur nyung bas 'bebs so// gnyis pa ni lus gnad gong bzhin la/ chu rdo khyud gang sgor mor yod pa gnyis chu la sbangs mkhal khung gnyis su bcug ska rags kyis bsdams/ 'bebs zhag bdun gyi bar zhogs brgya dgong brgya byed pa'o// gsum pa ni/ las la sbyar ba'i tshe/ skyes pa dang ma bral ring lus gnad gang bde la rlung phyir 'bud tsam thub 'dzin/ mi thub pa dang stod du brngubs/ yang phyir phu phyir 'dzin dmigs pa padma'i nang du ral gri me 'bar ba bsgom/ pho rog nyung ma'i lo ma'i grang thang btang*/ 'grems rlung dang bsre ba/ mthar phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par gzhag pas sbyor/ bud med la dmar cha shas che bas 'dren mi drag 'bod 'byed 'bebs gsum gtso bor bya'o// dbang bzhi pa dang spyod pa pho khrid ji bzhin no// de ltar mtshan ldan gyi bud med rdo rje phag mor btsan thabs su sbyor ba'i zhal gdams mkha' 'gro'i myur lam 'di yang yar 'dren byang chub sman ljongs zhes bya ba'i dben gnas nyams bde bar/ kun spangs rje'i rigs dbon chos dpon ma chos kyi dpal 'dren gyis bskul ba ltar padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o// 'dir zhugs pa thams cad kyang rdo rje phag mo'i go 'phang dam pa tshe 'di nyid la thob par gyur cig// /sarba maṅgalaṃ///
